segments.he: אֵין מְבִיאִין מִן הַגַּרְגְּרִין שֶׁנִּשְׁרוּ בְּמַיִם. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: שֶׁמֶן זַיִת כָּבוּשׁ, שָׁלוּק, שָׁרוּי, וְשֶׁל שְׁמָרִים, וְשֶׁל רֵיחַ רָע – לֹא יָבִיא, וְאִם הֵבִיא – פָּסוּל.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «One may not bring» meal offerings containing oil «from olives that were soaked in water,» nor from pickled olives, nor from boiled olives, and even if one did bring it, it is not valid. «The Sages taught» in a baraita: «Olive oil» produced from «pickled» olives, «boiled» olives, or olives «soaked» in water, «and» oil made «from» olive «sediment, and» oil «with a foul odor may not be brought» as part of a meal offering, «and» even «if one did bring» it, it is «not valid.»
